explanation: I grepped Mathlib for other statements of `StrictMono Real.exp` (`exp_strictMono`, `strictMono_exp`, `StrictMono rexp`). The only other `exp_strictMono` is `EReal.exp_strictMono`, which is about `EReal` and whose proof uses `Real.exp_strictMono`. Every other hit uses `Real.exp_strictMono` rather than restating it. In the same file, `Real.exp_lt_exp`, `Real.exp_le_exp` and `Real.exp_injective` are derived from the target theorem, so they are circular. I found no independent declaration stating strict monotonicity of the real exponential.
